full_judgment: 2. Opposite party Nos. Ito 17 as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 32 of 1996 before the Court of Assistant Judge, Sariakandi, Bogra for declaration of title. Defendant Nos. 2-10 entered appearance by filing written statement. During pendency of the suit plaintiffs filed an application under Order XXVI, rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure for issuing a commission appointing a survey knowing Advocate Commissioner for ascertaining the identity of the land given in the schedule of the deed of mortgage dated 13-11-1911, in comparison with 0.35 acre of land under plot No. 2800 and 0.43 acre of land under plot No. 2837 corresponding to CS Khatian No. 1488; the Assistant Judge, Sariakandi, Bogra by his order dated 19-5-1999 rejected the application for commission. Against which plaintiffs moved Civil Revision No. 3692 of 1999 before the High Division in which Rule was issued and after hearing a Single Bench of the High Court Division by it's judgment and order dated 5-9-1999 ultimately made the Rule absolute, allowing the application for issuance of commission with a direction to complete the formalities of commission within 06(six) months. Accordingly a local investigation was held; the Advocate Commissioner submitted his report and after hearing by order dated 03-9-2001 the report of Advocate Commissioner was rejected. Thereafter, the plaintiffs-opposite parties on 18-9-2001 filed an other application to issue a fresh commission to hold investigation by a survey knowing Advocate commissioner and learned Assistant Judge by his order allowed the same issuing a fresh commission appointing a survey knowing Advocate Commissioner for holding investigation for the purpose of ascertaining the identity of the land of mortgage deed dated 13-11-1911; learned Advocate Commissioner after holding investigation submitted his report on 4-4-2003. alongwith field book, sketch-map etc.; the defendants filed written objection against the report dated 4-4-2003; Advocate Commissioner was examined and cross-examined and after hearing and on perusal of the report dated 4-4- 2003, learned Assistant Judge by his order dated 15-1-2007 accepted the Advocate Commissioner's report.
